rules.summary: Polar lists Software and SaaS as acceptable products you may sell.
rules.quote: Software & SaaS;

rules.summary: Polar accepts digital products such as templates, eBooks, PDFs, and code.

rules.summary: Polar accepts premium content and access such as courses and GitHub repo access.
rules.quote: Premium content & access: Discord server access, GitHub repository access, courses, and content requiring a subscription.

rules.summary: Acceptable Polar sales are digital goods or services Polar or your API can fulfill immediately.
rules.quote: Generally, acceptable services are digital goods, software, or services that can be fulfilled by (1) Polar on your behalf (License Keys, File Downloads, GitHub or Discord invites, or private links) or (2) your site/service using our APIs to grant immediate access to digital assets or services for customers with a one-time purchase or subscription.

rules.summary: Stripe's list covers specific prohibited and restricted categories; ordinary software/SaaS is not listed.
rules.quote: This page provides information on the types of businesses, products, and industries that can’t use Stripe’s services.

rules.summary: Illegal products and services cannot use Stripe.
rules.quote: You must not use Stripe's services for any illegal activities or for the businesses or product types listed below.

rules.summary: Adult content and services, including qualifying AI-generated adult content, are prohibited.
rules.quote: Pornography and other mature audience content (including literature, imagery, and other media) designed for the purpose of sexual gratification

rules.summary: AI-generated content that meets Stripe's adult-content criteria is prohibited.
rules.quote: Any artificial-intelligence generated content that meets the above criteria

rules.summary: Games of chance with a monetary or material prize are prohibited.
rules.quote: Games of chance including gambling, internet gambling, casino games, sweepstakes and contests, and fantasy sports leagues with a monetary or material prize

rules.summary: Sale or distribution of licensed materials without authorization is prohibited.
rules.quote: Sales or distribution of music, movies, software, or any other licensed materials without appropriate authorization

rules.summary: Get-rich-quick schemes are prohibited as unfair or deceptive practices.
rules.quote: "Get rich quick" schemes, including investment opportunities or other services that promise high rewards to mislead consumers; schemes that claim to offer high rewards for very little effort or up-front work; and sites that promise fast and easy money

rules.summary: Telemarketing is listed among Stripe's prohibited unfair, deceptive, or abusive practices.
rules.quote: Telemarketing

rules.quote: Businesses that make outrageous claims, use deceptive testimonials, use high-pressure upselling, or use fake testimonials (with or without a written contract)

rules.summary: Extensions that add value and have a narrow single purpose are the intended CWS catalog.
rules.quote: Extensions should add value to the Chrome Web Store. If your extension is not particularly useful or unique, it doesn't belong on the Chrome Web Store.

rules.summary: An extension must have a single purpose that is narrow and easy to understand.
rules.quote: An extension must have a single purpose that is narrow and easy to understand.

rules.summary: Viruses, malware, and other destructive products are prohibited.
rules.quote: Don't transmit viruses, worms, defects, Trojan horses, malware, or any other products of a destructive nature.

rules.summary: Spyware, malicious scripts, and phishing scams are prohibited.
rules.quote: Spyware, malicious scripts, and phishing scams are also prohibited in the Chrome Web Store.

rules.summary: Facilitating unauthorized access such as circumventing paywalls is prohibited.
rules.quote: Do not facilitate unauthorized access to content on websites, such as circumventing paywalls or login restrictions.

rules.summary: Unauthorized download or streaming of copyrighted media is prohibited.
rules.quote: Do not encourage, facilitate, or enable the unauthorized access, download, or streaming of copyrighted content or media.

rules.summary: Cryptocurrency mining is not allowed.
rules.quote: We do not allow the mining of cryptocurrency.

rules.summary: Nudity, sexually explicit material, and traffic to commercial pornography are not allowed.
rules.quote: We don't allow content that contains nudity, graphic sex acts, sexually explicit material, or content that drives traffic to commercial pornography sites.

rules.summary: Real-money gambling and prediction markets are not allowed.
rules.quote: We don't allow content or services that facilitate or promote real money gambling or prediction markets, including but not limited to online casinos, sports betting, lotteries, or games of skill that offer prizes of cash or other value.

rules.summary: Facilitating sale of regulated goods (pharma, alcohol, tobacco, weapons, gambling, medical devices) is not allowed.
rules.quote: We don't allow the facilitation of the sale of regulated products or services. Regulated goods include pharmaceuticals, alcohol, tobacco, fireworks, weapons, gambling, or health and medical devices.

rules.summary: Content advocating hatred toward protected groups is not allowed.
rules.quote: We don't allow content or products that advocating against or inciting hatred towards groups of people based on their race or ethnic origin, religion, disability, gender, age, veteran status, nationality, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, or any other characteristic that is associated with systematic discrimination or marginalization.

rules.summary: Products that deceive or mislead users are not allowed.
rules.quote: We do not allow products that deceive or mislead users, including in the content, title, description, or screenshots.

rules.summary: Extensions that send messages on behalf of the user without confirmation are not allowed.
rules.quote: We don't allow extensions that send messages on behalf of the user without giving the user the ability to confirm the content and intended recipients.

rules.summary: Collection of web browsing activity is prohibited except for a prominently disclosed user-facing feature.
rules.quote: Collection and use of web browsing activity is prohibited, except to the extent required for a user-facing feature described prominently in the Product's Chrome Web Store page and in the Product's user interface.

rules.summary: Every CWS developer must declare Trader or Non-Trader under the EU Digital Services Act.
rules.quote: All developers on the Chrome Web Store are required to declare if they are a Trader or Non-Trader.

rules.summary: Trader legal name, phone, and address are posted publicly on the extension listing.
rules.quote: This information that traders provide will be posted publicly at the bottom of your extension listing.

rules.summary: A human must create the GitHub account; machine accounts are permitted if a human sets them up.
rules.quote: You must be a human to create an Account. Accounts registered by "bots" or other automated methods are not permitted.

rules.summary: GitHub permits one free machine account set up by an individual human who accepts the Terms.
rules.quote: A machine account is an Account set up by an individual human who accepts the Terms on behalf of the Account, provides a valid email address, and is responsible for its actions.

rules.summary: Accounts registered by bots or other automated methods are not permitted.
rules.quote: Accounts registered by "bots" or other automated methods are not permitted.

rules.summary: Using the GitHub API to download data for spamming or selling users' personal information is prohibited.
rules.quote: You may not use the API to download data or Content from GitHub for spamming purposes, including for the purposes of selling GitHub users' personal information, such as to recruiters, headhunters, and job boards.
